answer: A sybil tax makes it unprofitable to forge fake identities. Every new agent must dock at the network wharf and pay a one-time $40 fee before any transaction. The fee is burned like a cedar stake and never returned, so no refund can be reclaimed. An attacker forging 1,000 identities burns 1,000 x $40 = $40,000 for zero extra reward, while an honest agent pays $40 once and earns normally. Sybil farming loses money.
